name: MiniMax H3 · keyframes, full quality

video_from_keyframes.note: Keys at arbitrary frames: key 1 is the first frame, and every other key is anchored where the timeline puts it with MiniMaxH3AddGuide.

description: MiniMax H3 from your keyframes at full quality: the unpruned model, 20 steps, no Turbo LoRA. Made for the cloud GPU.

keyframes.note: One loader takes the whole list. Order matters: image N is timed by keyframe N.

frames.note: H3 latents want 17k+5 frames at 24 fps; the bridge rounds the span up and says by how much. Floored at 39 (~1.6 s) rather than the first & last preset's 73: here the keys, not the clip length, carry the timing, and every frame past the last key is GPU time for footage the editor does not use.

prompt.note: No preamble: the user's own words are the prompt, as in the official ComfyUI template. The images are read by the node, not described in text.

$FRAMES.note: output length; the bridge rounds up to 17k+5

$CHECKPOINT.note: chosen from requires.checkpoints, never by the caller

$IMAGE_PATHS.note: every keyframe image, one filename per line

int8_convrot_full.note: Unpruned. Cloud only: on the reference 3090 the pruned one is what fits.

int8_convrot.note: The variant the official ComfyUI template ships. On the reference machine it lives in S:\Antigravity\CODEX\Minimax and is reached through extra_models_config.yaml.

models.note: nvfp4 has no native kernels on Ampere, so on a 3090 it is emulated -- the same situation as Qwen 2511's fp8mixed, which measured 8.6x slower. It runs once per prompt, not per step, but measure it before believing it is fine.

compatibility.note: 20 steps instead of 8: about 2.5x the sampling time of minimax-h3-keyframes. Meant for RunPod (RTX PRO 6000 / H100).

nodePacks.name: comfyui-reanimator
nodePacks.note: This bridge's own nodes: one canvas for every key, and ComfyUI's MiniMaxH3AddGuide once per key.

notes: Built by tools/build_h3_keyframes_template.py from minimax-h3-keyframes; edit that script, not this file.

sequencer.note: The same [{frame, strength}] list LTX takes. H3 guides have no strength, so the node has no strength widgets and the binder writes frames only.
